annotations.title: Make micro-drama, short film or trailer

description: Make a 60-second micro-drama episode (hook, twist, cliffhanger; optionally a classic genre such as billionaire, werewolf or mafia), short film (a complete story) or movie trailer from an idea, vertical 9:16 or 16:9, in any of Film Studio's looks (live-action, anime, 3D animation, noir, horror, sci-fi, western, romance, comedy and more). Five 12-second scenes, each filmed in one pass with several cuts, the cast's faces kept from portraits and every line spoken and lip-synced, cut together with their own sound and one score over the finished edit, with free motion graphics (title card, name tags, end screen; each can be turned off), and saved to the Library. Not for music videos (pixeldojo_music_video) create is free and returns the plan and the exact price (about 380 credits for a regular episode, about 160 for mature work); produce films it; then call status until it is finished (10-15 minutes).

action.description: create (default, free): writes the episode plan (5 scenes unless scenes says, cast, lines) and returns drama_id and the price. Show the plan and price to the user and wait for their OK. produce (charged): films it. status (free): progress; call every ~60s until it returns the episode. redo (charged): re-film chosen beats of a finished episode or one waiting at the review, then it cuts again. cut (free): when the review flagged beats and the user wants it as it is, cut it now.

beats.description: Redo: the beat numbers to film again.

brand_color.description: Create: accent colour for the graphics, #RRGGBB. Default a warm gold.

cast.description: Create (optional): up to 5 characters to star (people, animals or creatures), each with a portrait on the PixelDojo CDN (a saved character from pixeldojo_library). Others get a portrait made for them.

image_url.description: A clear front-facing portrait on the PixelDojo CDN.

name.description: The character's name as the story uses it.

drama_id.description: From create. Required for produce, status and redo.

end_screen.description: Create: a 3.5-second "To be continued" end screen after the last line. Default on.

end_text.description: Create: the end screen's line, up to 60 characters. Default "Episode 2 coming soon".

idea.description: Create: the story in a line or two (who, the conflict, the twist).

kind.description: Create: micro-drama (default: episode one with a hook and a cliffhanger), short-film (a complete 60 s story) or trailer (sells a film that does not exist, never shows the ending).

logo_url.description: Create: a logo on the PixelDojo CDN for the end screen.

look.description: Create (optional): the visual style and genre. Default live-action (a micro-drama story type brings its own).

mature.description: Create: true for adult work (the server also detects it from the idea). Runs on the less-restricted engines.

name_tags.description: Create: a name and role tag the first time each character speaks. Default on.

notes.description: Redo (optional): what to fix in each of those beats, in the same order.

scenes.description: Create (optional): how many 12-second scenes, default 5. Pass it when the user names a count or a length (about 12 s a scene).

score.description: Create (optional): one score laid over the finished edit, on by default and included in the price. Pass false only when the user wants no music (dialogue and ambience only).

story_type.description: Create (optional, micro-drama only): the genre, which sets its promises (a hidden heir, a fated mate, a debt of blood...). Pick the one the idea fits; omit for anything else.

title_card.description: Create: the episode title over the opening hook. Default on.
